title: Naturality of the normalized rational tensor associator
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a scheme X on which l is invertible, use [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-constraints]. The prescribed rational tensor associator is natural in each of its three inputs: for f:K→K′, g:L→L′, h:M→M′, tensor(tensor(f,g),h)≫α(K′,L′,M′)=α(K,L,M)≫tensor(f,tensor(g,h)). These are exactly the normalized associator and tensor functor of the assigned coefficient constructions.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 07A4 and 0941; proved private integral_naturality and rational_naturality in lean/Sheaf/Paper/CommonStageTensorLineCoherenceNaturality.lean, extracted without importing its parent-dependent public theorem

proof.text: First reflect integral associator naturality by faithful coherent reduction. The reduction/tensor comparison is natural. Apply its naturality twice to the two nested tensor functors. The prescribed reduction equation identifies the integral associator with the system associator, whose naturality gives the square. Cancel the target comparison and use faithfulness.

Use the prescribed bilinear formulas for the rational tensor functor. On pure scalar tensors a⊗f, b⊗g, c⊗h, the two nested tensor maps are the localized integral maps multiplied by (ab)c and a(bc). The normalized rational associator is the localized integral one. Composition_tmul and associativity of scalar multiplication therefore reduce the desired square to integral naturality. Tensor-product induction in the three arrows handles zero and sums, proving the general equation.

lean.statement:
theorem rationalAssociator_natural
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    {K K' L L' M M' : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X}
    (f : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L') (h : M ⟶ M') :
    (rationalDerivedTensor l E X).map
        (Prod.mkHom ((rationalDerivedTensor l E X).map (Prod.mkHom f g)) h) ≫
        (pullbackTensorRationalAssociator l E X K' L' M').hom =
      (pullbackTensorRationalAssociator l E X K L M).hom ≫
        (rationalDerivedTensor l E X).map
          (Prod.mkHom f ((rationalDerivedTensor l E X).map (Prod.mkHom g h)))
